==Description==
'''D-175''' is a entity that might be a severe threat if you don't pay attention, more info bellow.

==Behavior==

'''D-175''' will hide in any of the lockers within the current room similar to [[M-134]], he will emit a black fog from the locker he's in it, if you enter the locker it muffles your audio and deals some dps over time, if you enter on it a second time it makes you be unable to exit the locker for a bit, making you get damaged, the third time you decide to enter, there will be no escape and you'll die to it.
==Strategy & Tips==
Pay close attention before going to the locker.

==Trivia==
* '''D-175''''s “locker trap” mechanic was an accident. It was a bug originally that '''D-175''' trapped you in the locker when you re-entered his locker, he was originally meant to just impair you not trap you in.
* '''D-175''' was meant to be release in "Update Executive" alongside [[D-55i]] and [[D-250]], but was left disabled due to it breaking a lot
